name: Monterra Wilds
description: Explore a living wilderness, discover elemental creatures, battle, catch them, level up and unlock powerful evolutions.

name: World Strike
description: Choose your country, pick your gun, and defend the arena against eight waves of rogue combat bots.

name: Avengers Arena
description: Four legendary heroes. One rooftop showdown. Pick your Avenger and unleash your superpower.

name: Candy Pop
description: Swap colorful candies, pop jelly, and create sweet combos on a trail of 24 magical match-three puzzles.

name: Iron Citadel
description: Enter a pixel fortress in a retro first-person shooter. Find the keys, blast robot sentries and face the Warden.

name: Chikoo & Bunty: Mischief Chase
description: Race through the neighbourhood, dodge obstacles, and collect stars and laddoos in a mischievous chase.

name: Dragon Keep TD
description: Build and upgrade arrow, frost, and cannon towers to protect the Dragon Crystal from ten monster waves.

name: Ghost Village
description: Join three ninjas and the Death Ninja Gang to protect an ancient mountain village from invading ghosts.

name: Iron Flight
description: Fly through the skyline, dodge enemy drones, and collect glowing energy cores to beat your best score.
